title: The rosaries, too, which he said constantly—for he carried his beads loose in his trousers’ pockets that he might tell them as he walked the streets—transformed themselves into coronals of flowers of such vague unearthly texture that they seemed to him as hueless and odourless as they were nameless.
html_source:
Rosaries are essentially prayer beads used by Catholics with which someone prays a series of prayers, a prayer per bead.

Stephen uses them compulsively to suppress any semblance of sin in his life. This is one of the first things offered in the narrative showing Stephen’s newly found dedication to religion.

Consider how Stephen uses rosaries so compulsively with how he considers God on a spiritual level—if beads are so important, how important is his religion on a spiritual level?
